reference.title: Scenario 1: using <topicgroup>to cluster related topics
reference.shortdesc: You are creating a product‑agnostic help system for a software suite that includes multiple modules

section.p: You are creating a product‑agnostic help system for a software suite that includes multiple modules (Client, Server, Admin UI). Each module has “Getting Started,” “Administration,” and “Troubleshooting” sections, but you don’t want to treat these as rigid “chapters” because different audiences reuse different combinations.
You use <topicgroup> to logically group these sets of topics under each module in the map:
